name: Selfmail
description: Your own mail on your own domain, as a page of your Aegis × Burrow dashboard. Accounts with passwords and roles, service accounts the machine answers for, API keys for other programs, preset responses, and invalid-address handling — HTML or plain text, sent through the machine's own mail agent, received through the default relay on every domain the machine has. Everything is kept in the addon's data folder.

update_card.title: {name} {version}
update_card.tagline: If the page ever loads without its looks, it now says why.
highlights: A missing stylesheet shows a plain notice at the top instead of a white page
The sidebar stays fully hidden on the sign-in page (a CSS override could leave an empty rail)
No behavior changes; mail, presets and forwarding work exactly as before

settings.label: Port
settings.help: Where the mail app listens, on the same address as its host. The dashboard's page reaches it there.

settings.label: Mailbox name
settings.help: The name of the mailbox before any account exists; the first account (created on first run) takes over.

settings.label: Sender name
settings.help: The name on the mail you send, e.g. "Ada Lovelace". Leave it empty for just the address.

settings.label: Inbound subdomain
settings.help: The public name for receiving mail, e.g. mail.your-domain. A relay delivers to it. Only used when a domain is linked.

settings.label: Publish the inbound address
settings.help: Burrow publishes a public HTTPS address that a mail relay posts your incoming mail to. Turn it off to keep everything local.

settings.label: Inbound secret
settings.help: The secret in the inbound URL a relay must know. Leave it empty and one is made for you, and kept in the data folder.
